windows_security_log_review_benchmark.source: Ultimate Windows Security — Windows Security Log Encyclopedia
windows_security_log_review_benchmark.semantic_authority: Microsoft official documentation plus controlled provider/channel/version evidence
windows_security_log_review_benchmark.ingestion_policy: Do not bulk-ingest third-party prose. UWS remains a controlled Quick Detail and coverage benchmark; every promoted Event ID requires independent Microsoft/provider evidence and provenance review.

completion_rule: A telemetry family may be declared complete only after its provider/channel/version denominator is frozen and every required identity reaches the declared encyclopedia-grade and release acceptance level. The Windows Security Log review benchmark spans listed Event IDs 1100 through 8191 but is sparse and is not itself a provider denominator. No family-specific percentage may be presented as all-Windows completeness.
